snippet_primary: "Stripe bought Lemon Squeezy in July 2024. At the time, most indie hackers shrugged. Stripe is developer-friendly, LS was growing fast, what's the worst that could happen? Almost two years later: nothing catastrophic, but enough to make you uneasy. Feature velocity has slowed. The roadmap has gone quiet. A platform built for indie hackers now has a corporate parent with different priorities. And when your SaaS depends on a Merchant of Record for global tax compliance, 'quiet roadmap' does not inspire confidence."
